craft.description: Legacy alias; treated as an ordinary new-work request.

init.description: Capture product truth in PRODUCT.md through a short interview; offers DESIGN.md when code exists and pre-configures live mode. Run once per project.

document.description: Record the incumbent visual system as DESIGN.md (tokens, type, spacing, components) from the codebase, confirming tone words with the user.

extract.description: Consolidate repeated patterns and values into shared tokens and components to stop design drift.

live.description: Browser variant mode: pick an element, choose an action, and review generated HTML+CSS alternatives hot-swapped into the running dev server.

adapt.description: Make a surface work across screen sizes, input types and platforms, including native conventions.

animate.description: Add purposeful motion and micro-interactions that clarify state and hierarchy.

audit.description: Score technical quality — accessibility, performance, theming, responsiveness — with a prioritized fix list.

bolder.description: Push a timid or generic design toward a stronger, more distinctive point of view.

clarify.description: Rewrite unclear labels, microcopy, errors and instructions so users know what to do.

colorize.description: Introduce strategic color to flat or monochrome interfaces without hurting contrast.

critique.description: Heuristic UX review combining design judgment with detector and browser evidence; ranked issues and next steps.

delight.description: Add tasteful personality and memorable moments where they serve the experience.

distill.description: Remove everything that does not earn its place; simplify structure, choices and decoration.

harden.description: Production readiness: error, empty and loading states, long content, i18n and edge cases.

onboard.description: Design first-run, empty states and activation paths that get users to value quickly.

layout.description: Fix spacing, rhythm, alignment and visual hierarchy.

optimize.description: Diagnose and fix UI performance — rendering, assets, layout shift, interaction latency.

overdrive.description: Go beyond conventional limits with ambitious, technically demanding visual work.

polish.description: Final pre-ship pass on details, consistency and craft.

quieter.description: Calm an overstimulating design: reduce noise, intensity and competing emphasis.

shape.description: Plan the UX and UI of a feature before writing code.

typeset.description: Improve type choices, scale, hierarchy and readability.
